title.zh: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding

current_state.zh: OpenAI announced three claimed research discoveries made with academic communities — progress on the Kakeya conjecture/local smoothing, a disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and a proof of existence for quantum chromodynamics and completions of the Standard Model.
current_state.en: OpenAI announced three claimed research discoveries made with academic communities — progress on the Kakeya conjecture/local smoothing, a disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and a proof of existence for quantum chromodynamics and completions of the Standard Model.

updates.what_changed_zh:
2026年10月26日，OpenAI 宣布其模型给出了三项长期悬而未决结果的自然语言证明：Kakeya 猜想相关的局部光滑（local smoothing）、指数时间假设（ETH）为假，以及量子色动力学与标准模型完备化的存在性。其中 Yang–Mills 存在性证明生成于2026年9月9日，QCD 证明生成于9月18日，发布被推迟至10月16日 Yang–Mills 结果的 Lean 形式化完成后才进行。

OpenAI 将此次发布定位为研究者如何验证并在此基础上继续推进，并称正因工作量庞大且复杂，才等到 Lean 形式化完成后才公布。具备复杂性理论背景的评论者认为，ETH 被推翻是其中影响最大的一项，因为 ETH 是许多困难性与下界结果的基石。

局部光滑方面的主张被认为一并解决了任意维度的 Kakeya 猜想与 Stein 限制性猜想，该问题自1991年起悬而未决。目前尚无对这些证明的独立验证报道；发布当日的报道称相关结果仍未经核实。

updates.background_zh: 局部光滑猜想由 Christopher Sogge 于1991年提出，位于调和分析一系列猜想的最上端：它蕴含 Bochner–Riesz 猜想，后者蕴含限制性猜想，再蕴含 Kakeya 猜想。指数时间假设认为 3-SAT 无法在亚指数时间内求解，被广泛用于推导困难性结果，包括参数化复杂性领域。Yang–Mills 存在性与质量间隙是克莱数学研究所于2000年设立的七个千禧年大奖难题之一。
updates.background_en: The local smoothing conjecture was proposed by Christopher Sogge in 1991 and sits at the top of a chain of harmonic-analysis conjectures: it implies the Bochner–Riesz conjecture, which implies the restriction conjecture, which implies the Kakeya conjecture. The Exponential Time Hypothesis posits that 3-SAT cannot be solved in sub-exponential time and is widely used to derive hardness results, including in parameterized complexity. Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 有复杂性理论背景的评论者讨论了 ETH 被推翻对现有困难性证明意味着什么，以及这是否应显著提高对 P=NP 的先验判断；有人指出 ETH 论文的作者之一也参与了讨论。也有人称成果出现的节奏“令人震撼”，同时不少人认为标题是为了预先化解常见的网络反弹而设计的，并把目光转向公告正文列出的三项结果。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters with complexity-theory backgrounds debated what an ETH refutation implies for existing hardness proofs and whether it should shift priors toward P=NP; one noted that an author of the ETH paper was participating in the discussion. Others called the pace of results "mind blowing," while several said the headline was crafted to preempt the usual backlash and pointed to the announcement text listing the three results.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这些主张会强化围绕可验证计算与机器辅助研究的 AI 与加密叙事，其中 Lean 证明等形式化产物被视为信任层；这一传导渠道影响的是与 AI、可验证计算相关代币的情绪面，而非任何链上资金流。该事件的市场相关性取决于独立验证结果，而非公告本身。
updates.market_impact_en: The claims feed the AI-crypto narrative around verifiable computation and machine-assisted research, where formalization artifacts such as Lean proofs are treated as a trust layer; that channel moves sentiment for AI- and verifiable-compute-related tokens rather than any on-chain flow. The story's market relevance depends on independent verification, not on the announcement itself.
